notes: Recent-degree PA with vertex aging (igraph_recent_degree_aging_game). Hybrid of GN-019 sliding window + GN-021 age-sweep. Throughput 2-5 Melem/s across all three variants on Darwin/M-series release build. The strong_aging variant is marginally slower than no_aging due to non-trivial pow(age, -1) evaluations in the age sweep. outpref_undirected adds per-vertex degree feedback into the BIT but cost is comparable. No oracle baseline: RNG state not portable (IGRAPH_EXPERIMENTAL in upstream C).
